description: SAMPLE layout for the demo, drawn over two runs of the Jülich bottleneck experiment played at once (not a real venue): an entry corridor 5.6 m wide narrows to the main gate into the hall; a second queue waits at side door B, which also leads into the hall. The outer queue can be held at the barrier before both.

places.name: Outer queue barrier
places.note: stewards can stop the inflow here
